name: Cave Tablet

pages.text: Find in an Underground Cabin; research with paper at a Spelunkery Table.

pages.title: Beginning research
pages.text: Look for Underground Cabins with loot containers and a Spelunkery Table. Tablets carry a particular cave-biome identity: identical icons can represent different discoveries.

pages.title: Research
pages.text: Open the Spelunkery Table, place the tablet and paper in their respective slots, and complete its native symbol game. An attempt consumes one tablet. Success additionally consumes paper and produces a codex for its biome; failure breaks the tablet without producing a codex.

pages.title: Two uses
pages.text: A tablet also crafts a Cave Compendium with a book and a gold nugget. Choose whether you need a new book or research; reading JEM Handbook does not replace deciphering.
